name: Video to Video
description: Video to Video currently shows only a title banner. To transform a video, open Video Studio and attach your clip.
shortDescription: Title page only; transform videos in Video Studio's video-to-video mode.
fullDescription: Video to Video (#/video-to-video) currently shows only a banner with the title 'Video to Video' and the line 'Transform and enhance your videos with AI-powered tools'. The page has no buttons, upload, prompt or Generate. (Its code builds a 'Transform Your Videos' section with 'Get Started Free', '🎯 GTM Boost' and a video upload button, but never adds it to the page.) To work on a video, open Video Studio (#/video) from the side menu's Video button and attach a video: the studio switches to its video-to-video model list (77 entries; the first is AI Video Watermark Remover), with workflows such as Edit video, Extend uploaded video and Motion transfer.
bestFor: Anyone looking for video-to-video; the real tools are in Video Studio.
whenToUse: You arrived here looking for video-to-video and need to know where to go.
whenToUseAnother: Use Video Studio (#/video) to attach a video and run watermark removal, edit, extend or motion transfer.
Use Video Tools (#/videotools) for other video utilities.
Use Upscale Suite (#/upscale) to increase resolution.
keyFeatures: The side menu's Video button opens Video Studio.
Video Studio's video upload button switches it to video-to-video models.

featureExplanations.explanation: The page shows a banner titled 'Video to Video' with 'Transform and enhance your videos with AI-powered tools'. Nothing else is shown.
featureExplanations.restrictions: There are no buttons, uploads or Generate on this page.

featureExplanations.feature: Open Video Studio from the side menu
featureExplanations.explanation: Click 'Video' in the left side menu to open Video Studio (#/video), where video-to-video actually happens.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: This page has no link of its own to the tools.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Video Studio opens in text-to-video until you attach a video.

featureExplanations.explanation: In Video Studio, the video button (tooltip 'Upload video to remove watermark') attaches a video. The studio then switches to its video-to-video list, whose first model is 'AI Video Watermark Remover'; other workflows include Edit video, Extend uploaded video and Motion transfer.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Video uploads are limited to 50MB (shared upload limits). Some workflows need a prompt or a character image; see the Video Studio guide.

howToUse: 1. Click 'Video' in the left side menu to open Video Studio (#/video). 2. Click the video button (tooltip 'Upload video to remove watermark') and attach your clip. 3. The studio switches to video-to-video models; pick a workflow or model. 4. Add a prompt if the model needs one and click Generate.
howToSteps: Open Video Studio from the side menu.
Attach your video with the video button.
Choose a video-to-video model or workflow.
gettingStarted: Go to Video Studio and attach a short clip.
Try the default AI Video Watermark Remover, which needs no prompt.
requiredInputs: None on this page; a video file is needed in Video Studio.

inputDetails.name: Video file (in Video Studio)
inputDetails.description: The clip to transform, attached with Video Studio's video button.

generationModes: None on this page (video-to-video happens in Video Studio)

modeExplanations.description: Starts when you attach a video in Video Studio; the first model is AI Video Watermark Remover.
modeExplanations.useCase: Remove watermarks, edit, extend or re-animate footage.

modelCapabilities: This page lists no models. Video Studio's video-to-video list has 77 entries (src/lib/models.js v2vModels), starting with AI Video Watermark Remover.
limitations: The page shows only a banner; its call-to-action section, GTM Boost and upload button are built in code but not displayed.
No link to Video Studio on the page itself; use the side menu.

limitationDetails.impact: You cannot start a video-to-video job here.
limitationDetails.workaround: Open Video Studio from the side menu and attach your video.

troubleshooting: The page is empty below the banner: that is the current page design (the rest of the section is not added). Use Video Studio.

steps: In Video Studio, click the video button next to the prompt.

commonProblems.problem: Nothing to click on Video to Video
commonProblems.whyItHappens: The page only adds its banner.

exampleWorkflows.title: Remove a watermark from a clip
steps: Open Video Studio from the side menu.
Click the video button and attach the clip.

useCases.title: Finding the video-to-video tools
useCases.description: Get from this page to the place where video transformations run.

faqs.question: Why is this page empty?
faqs.answer: It currently shows only its banner. The video-to-video tools are in Video Studio: attach a video there.

glossary.Video-to-video: Making a new or changed video from a video you supply.
glossary.Watermark remover: A model that removes logos, captions or overlay text from a clip.

tips: Keep clips under 50MB before attaching them in Video Studio.
bestPractices: Go straight to Video Studio for video-to-video work.

relatedStudioGuidance.why: Video Studio has the video upload and the video-to-video models.

relatedStudioGuidance.whenToMove: For trimming, converting and similar jobs.
When the clip needs to be sharper or larger.
